prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1454; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported no visible damage beyond scuffing on passenger-side panels. Police report requested. Bodily injury reported by claimant, described as back strain. Claimant is represented by counsel; all communication to be routed through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Requested the medical records and the treatment history for the back strain. Attorney's office acknowledged the request and stated records will follow. Insured vehicle appraisal scheduled for next available slot.

Entry 3: Appraisal completed on insured vehicle. Damage limited to the right rear quarter panel and rear door trim. Repair estimate received from the shop and under review. Liability position still pending the police report and statements from both drivers.

Entry 4: Police report received. It notes the other driver failed to yield during the lane change, which supports our insured's account. Liability assessment updated to favor the insured, subject to final review. Attorney's office notified of preliminary liability position in writing.

Entry 5: Medical records received from the claimant's attorney, showing a diagnosis of lumbar strain with a treatment plan of physical therapy and follow-up in four weeks. Bodily injury evaluation referred to the injury review unit. Attorney advised that the file will remain open pending completion of treatment. Reserve reviewed and kept at current level.
